targetTexts.1: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.
targetTexts.2: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
targetTexts.3: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
targetTexts.4: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
targetTexts.5: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.
targetTexts.6: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
targetTexts.7: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
targetTexts.8: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
targetTexts.9: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”
targetTexts.10: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
targetTexts.11: From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,
targetTexts.12: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.
targetTexts.13: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
targetTexts.14: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
targetTexts.15: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
targetTexts.16: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
targetTexts.17: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
targetTexts.18: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans were scattered,
targetTexts.19: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
targetTexts.20: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
targetTexts.21: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.
targetTexts.22: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
targetTexts.23: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
targetTexts.24: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
targetTexts.25: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
targetTexts.26: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
targetTexts.29: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
targetTexts.30: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
targetTexts.31: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
targetTexts.32: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their generations and nations. From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
